这是谁的房间？ (Zhè shì shéi de fángjiān?) - Whose room is this?
这是我和我丈夫的，旁边那个小的房间是我女儿的。 (Zhè shì wǒ hé wǒ zhàngfu de, pángbiān nàge xiǎo de fángjiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér de.) - It's my husband's and mine. The small one beside it is my daughter's.
你女儿的房间真漂亮！ (Nǐ nǚ'ér de fángjiān zhēn piàoliang!) - Your daughter's room is so pretty!
都是粉色的。 (Dōu shì fěnsè de.) - It's all pink.
是啊，粉色是我女儿最喜欢的颜色。 (Shì a, fěnsè shì wǒ nǚ'ér zuì xǐhuan de yánsè.) - Yes. Pink is her favorite color.
你看见我的杯子了吗？ (Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de bēizi le ma?) - Have you seen my cup?
这里有几个杯子，哪个是你的？ (Zhèli yǒu jǐ ge bēizi, nǎge shì nǐ de?) - Here are a few cups. Which one is yours?
左边那个红色的是我的。 (Zuǒbian nàge hóngsè de shì wǒ de.) - The red one on the left is mine.
给你。 (Gěi nǐ.) - Here you are.
这本书不是我的。 (Zhè běn shū bú shì wǒ de.) - This book is not mine. (= my book)
这个杯子是昨天买的。 (Zhège bēizi shì zuótiān mǎi de.) - This cup was bought yesterday. (= the cup bought yesterday)
这块手表是你的吗？ (Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo shì nǐ de ma?) - Is this watch yours? (= your watch)
我看一下。 (Wǒ kàn yíxià.) - Let me take a look.
你休息一下吧。 (Nǐ xiūxi yíxià ba.) - Have a rest.
我问一下老师。 (Wǒ wèn yíxià lǎoshī.) - I'll ask the teacher.
你真好！ (Nǐ zhēn hǎo!) - You are really nice!
今天天气真好！ (Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn hǎo!) - The weather is really nice today!
你女儿的房间真漂亮！ (Nǐ nǚ'ér de fángjiān zhēn piàoliang!) - Your daughter's room is so pretty!
爸爸的手表多少钱？ (Bàba de shǒubiǎo duōshao qián?) - How much is Dad's watch?
送报纸的来了吗？ (Sòng bàozhǐ de lái le ma?) - Has the person who delivers the newspaper come?
旁边那个小的房间是谁的？ (Pángbiān nàge xiǎo de fángjiān shì shéi de?) - Whose is the small room beside it?
她女儿的房间怎么样？ (Tā nǚ'ér de fángjiān zěnmeyàng?) - What is her daughter's room like?
哪个杯子是她的？ (Nǎge bēizi shì tā de?) - Which cup is hers?
外面下雨，他们都在____里呢。 (Wàimian xià yǔ, tāmen dōu zài ____ li ne.) - It's raining outside; they are all inside the ____ (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
李先生的手表很好，三____多块钱。 (Lǐ xiānsheng de shǒubiǎo hěn hǎo, sān ____ duō kuài qián.) - Mr. Li's watch is very good; it costs three ____ and more than a few yuan (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
我觉得左边那个____的漂亮。 (Wǒ juéde zuǒbian nàge ____ de piàoliang.) - I think the ____ one on the left is pretty (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
今天____牛奶的来了，报纸的没来。 (Jīntiān ____ niúnǎi de lái le, bàozhǐ de méi lái.) - Today the person who ____ milk has come; the newspaper person hasn't (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
这个红色的杯子是你的吗？ (Zhège hóngsè de bēizi shì nǐ de ma?) - Is this red cup yours?
不是我的。 (Bú shì wǒ de.) - It's not mine.
旁边粉色的杯子是你的吗？ (Pángbiān fěnsè de bēizi shì nǐ de ma?) - Is the pink cup beside it yours?
是我的。 (Shì wǒ de.) - It's mine.
左边的房间是我爸爸妈妈的，他们的房间很大。 (Zuǒbian de fángjiān shì wǒ bàba māma de, tāmen de fángjiān hěn dà.) - The room on the left is my parents'; their room is very big.
旁边的是我的，我的房间是粉色的。 (Pángbiān de shì wǒ de, wǒ de fángjiān shì fěnsè de.) - The one beside it is mine; my room is pink.
电脑在桌子上，桌子在床旁边。 (Diànnǎo zài zhuōzi shang, zhuōzi zài chuáng pángbiān.) - The computer is on the table, and the table is beside the bed.
生日快乐！ (Shēngrì kuàilè!) - Happy birthday!
这是送给你的！ (Zhè shì sòng gěi nǐ de!) - This is for you!
是什么？ (Shì shénme?) - What is it?
是一本书吗？ (Shì yì běn shū ma?) - Is it a book?
对，这本书是我写的。 (Duì, zhè běn shū shì wǒ xiě de.) - Yes. A book written by me.
太谢谢你了！ (Tài xièxie nǐ le!) - Thank you so much!
早上有你一个电话。 (Zǎoshang yǒu nǐ yí ge diànhuà.) - Someone called you this morning.
电话是谁打的？ (Diànhuà shì shéi dǎ de?) - Who called?
不知道，是儿子接的。 (Bù zhīdào, shì érzi jiē de.) - I don't know. Our son answered it.
好，晚上我问一下儿子。 (Hǎo, wǎnshang wǒ wèn yíxià érzi.) - OK. I'll ask our son about it this evening.
你喜欢踢足球吗？ (Nǐ xǐhuan tī zúqiú ma?) - Do you like playing football?
非常喜欢。 (Fēicháng xǐhuan.) - Yes, very much.
你是什么时候开始踢足球的？ (Nǐ shì shénme shíhou kāishǐ tī zúqiú de?) - When did you begin to play football?
我十一岁的时候开始踢足球，已经踢了十年了。 (Wǒ shíyī suì de shíhou kāishǐ tī zúqiú, yǐjīng tī le shí nián le.) - I was 11 when I began to play football. It has been 10 years.
你在这儿工作多长时间了？ (Nǐ zài zhèr gōngzuò duō cháng shíjiān le?) - How long have you been working here?
已经两年多了，我是2011年来的。 (Yǐjīng liǎng nián duō le, wǒ shì èr líng yī yī nián lái de.) - More than two years, since 2011.
你认识谢先生吗？ (Nǐ rènshi Xiè xiānsheng ma?) - Do you know Mr. Xie?
认识，我们是大学同学，这个工作是他帮我介绍的。 (Rènshi, wǒmen shì dàxué tóngxué, zhège gōngzuò shì tā bāng wǒ jièshào de.) - Yes. He is my college classmate. He recommended me for this job.
这本书是我买的。 (Zhè běn shū shì wǒ mǎi de.) - I bought this book.
晚饭是妈妈做的。 (Wǎnfàn shì māma zuò de.) - Mom cooked dinner.
电话是谁打的？ (Diànhuà shì shéi dǎ de?) - Who made the phone call?
这个汉字不是大卫写的。 (Zhège Hànzì bú shì Dàwèi xiě de.) - This Chinese character was not written by David.
苹果不是王方买的。 (Píngguǒ bú shì Wáng Fāng mǎi de.) - The apples were not bought by Wang Fang.
电话不是我接的。 (Diànhuà bú shì wǒ jiē de.) - I did not answer the phone.
今天早上八点的时候我没在家。 (Jīntiān zǎoshang bā diǎn de shíhou wǒ méi zài jiā.) - I was not at home at eight o'clock this morning.
我十八岁的时候一个人来到北京。 (Wǒ shíbā suì de shíhou yí ge rén láidào Běijīng.) - I came to Beijing alone when I was eighteen.
我十一岁的时候开始踢足球。 (Wǒ shíyī suì de shíhou kāishǐ tī zúqiú.) - I began to play football when I was eleven.
我睡觉的时候，我妈妈在做饭。 (Wǒ shuìjiào de shíhou, wǒ māma zài zuò fàn.) - While I was sleeping, my mother was cooking.
麦克到学校的时候下雨了。 (Màikè dào xuéxiào de shíhou xià yǔ le.) - It rained when Mike got to school.
王老师工作的时候，她丈夫开车去医院了。 (Wáng lǎoshī gōngzuò de shíhou, tā zhàngfu kāi chē qù yīyuàn le.) - While Teacher Wang was working, her husband drove to the hospital.
王老师已经回家了。 (Wáng lǎoshī yǐjīng huí jiā le.) - Teacher Wang has already gone home.
我的身体已经好了。 (Wǒ de shēntǐ yǐjīng hǎo le.) - My health has already recovered.
足球我已经踢了十年了。 (Zúqiú wǒ yǐjīng tī le shí nián le.) - I have already played football for ten years.
这本书是谁写的？ (Zhè běn shū shì shéi xiě de?) - Who wrote this book?
早上的电话是谁接的？ (Zǎoshang de diànhuà shì shéi jiē de?) - Who answered the phone call this morning?
他是什么时候开始踢足球的？ (Tā shì shénme shíhou kāishǐ tī zúqiú de?) - When did he begin to play football?
他在那儿工作多长时间了？ (Tā zài nàr gōngzuò duō cháng shíjiān le?) - How long has he been working there?
工作是谁帮他介绍的？ (Gōngzuò shì shéi bāng tā jièshào de?) - Who recommended the job to him?
我在做饭呢，是马丁____的电话。 (Wǒ zài zuò fàn ne, shì Mǎdīng ____ de diànhuà.) - I'm cooking; it was a call from Martin (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
这个工作是王方帮我____，我想请她吃饭。 (Zhège gōngzuò shì Wáng Fāng bāng wǒ ____, wǒ xiǎng qǐng tā chī fàn.) - Wang Fang helped me ____ this job; I want to invite her to dinner (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
这本书是我写的，我是二十岁____开始写书的。 (Zhè běn shū shì wǒ xiě de, wǒ shì èrshí suì ____ kāishǐ xiě shū de.) - I wrote this book; I began writing books at the age of twenty (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).

我是六岁开始打篮球的，我____喜欢打篮球。 (Wǒ shì liù suì kāishǐ dǎ lánqiú de, wǒ ____ xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú.) - I began playing basketball at the age of six; I ____ like playing basketball (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
我学习汉语。 (Wǒ xuéxí Hànyǔ.) - I study Chinese.
他哥哥是一名医生。 (Tā gēge shì yì míng yīshēng.) - His elder brother is a doctor.
王小姐买了几件衣服。 (Wáng xiǎojiě mǎile jǐ jiàn yīfu.) - Miss Wang bought several pieces of clothing.
他们高兴得跳了起来。 (Tāmen gāoxìng de tiàole qilai.) - They were so happy that they jumped up.
大卫打篮球打得非常好。 (Dàwèi dǎ lánqiú dǎ de fēicháng hǎo.) - David plays basketball extremely well.
今天的羊肉做得很好吃。 (Jīntiān de yángròu zuò de hěn hǎochī.) - Today's mutton is cooked very deliciously.
这个笔是你买的吗？ (Zhège bǐ shì nǐ mǎi de ma?) - Did you buy this pen?
不是，是我妈妈买的。 (Bú shì, shì wǒ māma mǎi de.) - No, my mother bought it.
这个汉字是你写的吗？ (Zhège Hànzì shì nǐ xiě de ma?) - Did you write this Chinese character?
对，是我写的。 (Duì, shì wǒ xiě de.) - Yes, I wrote it.
这个菜是谁做的？ (Zhège cài shì shéi zuò de?) - Who cooked this dish?
是妈妈做的。 (Shì māma zuò de.) - Mom cooked it.
苹果是你买的吗？ (Píngguǒ shì nǐ mǎi de ma?) - Did you buy the apples?
不是我买的。 (Bú shì wǒ mǎi de.) - I didn't buy them.
在（饭馆）吃饭 (Zài (fànguǎn) chī fàn) - eating at (a restaurant)
在（咖啡馆）喝咖啡 (Zài (kāfēiguǎn) hē kāfēi) - drinking coffee at (a café)
在（学校）考试 (Zài (xuéxiào) kǎoshì) - taking a test at (school)
在（商店）买衣服 (Zài (shāngdiàn) mǎi yīfu) - buying clothes at (a store)
晚上我们去饭馆吃饭，怎么样？ (Wǎnshang wǒmen qù fànguǎn chī fàn, zěnmeyàng?) - Let's go to a restaurant for dinner. What do you think?
我不想去外面吃，我想在家吃。 (Wǒ bù xiǎng qù wàimiàn chī, wǒ xiǎng zài jiā chī.) - I don't want to eat out. I want to eat at home.
那你准备做什么呢？ (Nà nǐ zhǔnbèi zuò shénme ne?) - What are you planning to cook?
就做你爱吃的鱼吧。 (Jiù zuò nǐ ài chī de yú ba.) - I'm thinking of fish, your favorite.
帮我看一下这件衣服怎么样。 (Bāng wǒ kàn yíxià zhè jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng.) - What do you think of this garment?
颜色还可以，就是有点儿大。 (Yánsè hái kěyǐ, jiùshì yǒudiǎnr dà.) - The color is OK, but it seems too large.
这件小的怎么样？ (Zhè jiàn xiǎo de zěnmeyàng?) - What about this small one?
这件不错，就买这件吧。 (Zhè jiàn búcuò, jiù mǎi zhè jiàn ba.) - This one is good. Take this one.
今天去不去打球？ (Jīntiān qù bu qù dǎ qiú?) - Will you go to play ball today?
这两天有点儿累，不去打球了。 (Zhè liǎng tiān yǒudiǎnr lèi, bú qù dǎ qiú le.) - No, I won't. I've been feeling tired these days.
你在做什么呢？ (Nǐ zài zuò shénme ne?) - What are you doing?
是在想昨天的考试吗？ (Shì zài xiǎng zuótiān de kǎoshì ma?) - Are you thinking about yesterday's test?

是啊，我觉得听和说还可以，读和写不好，很多字我都不知道是什么意思。 (Shì a, wǒ juéde tīng hé shuō hái kěyǐ, dú hé xiě bù hǎo, hěn duō zì wǒ dōu bù zhīdào shì shénme yìsi.) - Yes. I think I did OK in listening and speaking, but not in reading and writing; I didn't know the meanings of many characters.
休息一下吧，喝咖啡吗？ (Xiūxi yíxià ba, hē kāfēi ma?) - Let's take a rest. Would you like some coffee?
不喝了，我已经喝两杯了。 (Bù hē le, wǒ yǐjīng hē liǎng bēi le.) - No, thanks. I've already had two cups.
是啊，咖啡喝多了对身体不好。 (Shì a, kāfēi hē duō le duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.) - Right. Too much coffee is bad for our health.
以后我少喝一点儿，每天喝一杯。 (Yǐhòu wǒ shǎo hē yìdiǎnr, měi tiān hē yì bēi.) - I'll drink less coffee. One cup a day.
你不想去，就在家休息吧。 (Nǐ bù xiǎng qù, jiù zài jiā xiūxi ba.) - If you don't want to go, just rest at home.
这儿的咖啡不错，就喝咖啡吧。 (Zhèr de kāfēi búcuò, jiù hē kāfēi ba.) - The coffee here is good, so let's have coffee.
就做你爱吃的鱼吧。 (Jiù zuò nǐ ài chī de yú ba.) - Let's just cook the fish you love to eat.
你身体怎么样？ (Nǐ shēntǐ zěnmeyàng?) - How is your health?
还好。 (Hái hǎo.) - Not bad.
这件衣服大吗？ (Zhè jiàn yīfu dà ma?) - Is this garment big?
还行，不太大。 (Hái xíng, bú tài dà.) - It's OK, not too big.
昨天的考试怎么样？ (Zuótiān de kǎoshì zěnmeyàng?) - How was yesterday's test?
我觉得听和说还可以，读和写不好。 (Wǒ juéde tīng hé shuō hái kěyǐ, dú hé xiě bù hǎo.) - I think my listening and speaking are OK, but reading and writing are not good.
今天天气有点儿冷。 (Jīntiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng.) - The weather is a bit cold today.
我昨天有点儿累。 (Wǒ zuótiān yǒudiǎnr lèi.) - I was a bit tired yesterday.
这件衣服有点儿大。 (Zhè jiàn yīfu yǒudiǎnr dà.) - This garment is a bit big.
今天晚上他们在哪儿吃饭？ (Jīntiān wǎnshang tāmen zài nǎr chī fàn?) - Where are they eating tonight?
她觉得那件衣服怎么样？ (Tā juéde nà jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng?) - What does she think of that garment?
她今天为什么不去打球了？ (Tā jīntiān wèi shénme bú qù dǎ qiú le?) - Why isn't she going to play ball today?
她觉得昨天的考试怎么样？ (Tā juéde zuótiān de kǎoshì zěnmeyàng?) - What does she think of yesterday's test?
他为什么以后每天就喝一杯咖啡？ (Tā wèi shénme yǐhòu měi tiān jiù hē yì bēi kāfēi?) - Why will he drink only one cup of coffee a day from now on?
这件衣服____不错，就是有点儿小。 (Zhè jiàn yīfu ____ búcuò, jiùshì yǒudiǎnr xiǎo.) - This garment is ____ good, but it's a bit small (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
今天____晚，我们明天再看吧。 (Jīntiān ____ wǎn, wǒmen míngtiān zài kàn ba.) - It's ____ late today; let's watch it again tomorrow (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
这个咖啡馆的咖啡____，我每天来喝一杯。 (Zhège kāfēiguǎn de kāfēi ____, wǒ měi tiān lái hē yì bēi.) - The coffee at this café is ____; I come to have a cup every day (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
你们不去外面吃，我现在____准备晚饭。 (Nǐmen bú qù wàimiàn chī, wǒ xiànzài ____ zhǔnbèi wǎnfàn.) - Since you are not going out to eat, I will ____ prepare dinner now (fill-in-the-blank picture exercise).
那是我妈妈做的中国菜。 (Nà shì wǒ māma zuò de Zhōngguó cài.) - That is the Chinese dish my mother cooked.
那个学校是李老师工作了很多年的地方。 (Nàge xuéxiào shì Lǐ lǎoshī gōngzuòle hěn duō nián de dìfang.) - That school is the place where Teacher Li worked for many years.
我最喜欢红色的衣服。 (Wǒ zuì xǐhuan hóngsè de yīfu.) - I like red clothes best.
你的杯子就在那儿。 (Nǐ de bēizi jiù zài nàr.) - Your cup is right there.
大卫的狗飞一样地跑了过去。 (Dàwèi de gǒu fēi yíyàng de pǎole guoqu.) - David's dog ran over as fast as flying.
我爸爸是医生，每天从早到晚忙工作。 (Wǒ bàba shì yīshēng, měi tiān cóng zǎo dào wǎn máng gōngzuò.) - My father is a doctor; every day from morning to night he is busy working.
